UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Student profile associated with a Google account (non-PII display metadata).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

displayName.description: Student display name from Google account.

photoURL.description: Optional avatar URL from Google account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the student profile was last updated.

NotebookWord.title: NotebookWord
NotebookWord.description: A vocabulary word saved to a student's personal Vocabulary Notebook.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner student.

definition.description: Uzbek meaning (for B1) or English definition (for B2/C1).

collocations.description: Up to 10 common collocations for the word.

savedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when the word was saved.

nextReviewDate.description: Epoch milliseconds for next scheduled review.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the notebook entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the notebook entry was last updated.

LearnedWord.title: LearnedWord
LearnedWord.description: A target vocabulary word marked as learned by a student for the Vocabulary Gym.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner student.

cefrLevel.description: CEFR level of the learned word.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the word was marked as learned.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each student's non-PII Google profile metadata.

/users/{userId}/notebook/{wordId}.description: Subcollection storing each student's personal saved Vocabulary Notebook words.

/users/{userId}/learned/{wordId}.description: Subcollection storing each student's learned vocabulary word IDs for the Vocabulary Gym.
